Game Overview

In Block Ninja, the core idea is straightforward: master your reflexes in Block Ninja. Guide two agile ninjas through a gauntlet of challenging obstacles. Swiftly swipe them up and down to avoid ruin and achieve high scores. Your lightning-fast moves and precision timing are all that stand between triumph and defeat in this thrilling arcade adventure.
